name: Better WARP
description: Cloudflare WARP over AmneziaWG as a protocol of the subscription: add a WARP inbound (panel build with it), attach clients, and each gets WARP nodes in the same four forms as an AmneziaWG node, with their own device, WARP+ license, and a check and endpoint scanner (Better Cores). Also gives this server's Xray a WARP outbound with routing rules (OpenAI, Netflix, a protocol by its inbound tag).
author: AllIsA1
